errors.description: This final characterization is false without restricting d to primes occurring initially: for any absent prime p, every positive exponent divides all zero valuations, so arbitrarily large extra prime powers may be included. This does not affect the preceding proof or boxed formula.
errors.quote: the unique maximal $d$ with $v_p(d) \mid v_p(a_i)$ for all $p$ and all $i$.

parsed.notes: The termination argument and the prime-wise valuation invariant are rigorous and fully establish both requested conclusions. Only the optional final remark contains a readily removable error.
